title: Percakapan customer service + sarkasme
description: Analisis transkrip chat pelanggan dan agen CS sekaligus mendeteksi sarkasme pelanggan: maksud, status penyelesaian, langkah berikutnya, eskalasi, urgensi, kualitas agen, risiko churn, emosi akhir, sarkasme, dan sikap asli pelanggan.

intent.instructions: What does the customer mainly want in this conversation?

criteria.info: asks for information, a price, how-to, or product details
criteria.gangguan: reports a technical problem, outage, error, or something not working
criteria.tagihan: billing, payment, double charge, invoice, or refund
criteria.pengiriman: order status, late, lost, or damaged delivery
criteria.akun: login, password, account access, or changing personal data
criteria.berhenti: wants to cancel, unsubscribe, or close the account
criteria.komplain_layanan: complains about staff, response time, or how they were treated
criteria.lainnya: anything else, greetings, or small talk

resolution_status.instructions: At the end of the conversation, is the customer's issue resolved?

criteria.selesai: the issue is solved and the customer confirms or accepts it
criteria.dalam_proses: the agent is working on it or promised a follow-up
criteria.menunggu_pelanggan: the agent is waiting for data, a photo, or a reply from the customer
criteria.belum_selesai: the issue is not solved and there is no clear next step

next_action.instructions: What should the support team do next?

criteria.tutup_tiket: close the ticket, nothing left to do
criteria.beri_jawaban: answer the customer's question or give instructions
criteria.minta_data: ask the customer for more details or proof
criteria.cek_teknis: open a technical check or send a technician
criteria.proses_refund: process a refund, compensation, or replacement
criteria.eskalasi: hand over to a supervisor, specialist, or another team
criteria.follow_up: contact the customer again later to confirm

needs_escalation.instructions: Should this conversation be escalated to a supervisor or specialist?

criteria.false: the front-line agent can handle it
criteria.true: the customer asks for a manager, threatens legal action or going viral, or the agent cannot solve it

urgency.instructions: How urgent is the customer's issue?
criteria: low: a question or feedback with no time pressure
medium: needs handling within a day
high: service down, money lost, or the customer is blocked right now

agent_quality.instructions: How well did the agent handle the conversation (polite, clear, helpful, fast)? If there is no agent reply, answer average.
criteria: poor: rude, wrong, or ignores the customer
average: polite but generic or incomplete
good: polite, clear, and moves the issue forward
excellent: empathetic, precise, and solves the issue

churn_risk.instructions: Does the customer threaten or hint that they will cancel, stop using the service, or switch to a competitor?

criteria.false: no sign the customer will leave
criteria.true: the customer threatens or hints to cancel, leave, or switch

final_emotion.instructions: What is the customer's emotion at the END of the conversation?

sarcasm.instructions: Is the CUSTOMER being sarcastic, i.e. saying something nice ("mantap", "keren", "hebat", "bagus banget", "terima kasih banyak ya", "pelayanan terbaik") while actually complaining about the product, the price, or slow, wrong, or failed service?

criteria.false: the customer means their words literally (real thanks or a plain complaint)
criteria.true: praise or thanks is ironic: it sits next to a complaint, a bad result, a long wait, a repeated problem, or a refusal to buy or use it again

real_attitude.instructions: Taking sarcasm and slang into account, what is the customer's REAL attitude toward the company at the end of the conversation?

criteria.positif: genuinely satisfied with the help they got
criteria.negatif: genuinely dissatisfied, annoyed, or ready to leave, even if they use polite or praising words

would_buy_again.instructions: Will the writer buy or use this product or service again?

criteria.ya: yes, will buy or use it again
criteria.tidak: no, will not buy or use it again
